disclaimer: Unofficial demo assets. HUB24 brand artwork is referenced for visual fidelity only. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to HUB24 Limited (ASX:HUB).
note: hub24.com.au, hds.hub24.com.au and every public logo mirror are unreachable from the restricted build environment (egress allowlist rejects the domain, connection reset on curl). The wordmark artwork below was therefore hand-authored to match the HUB24 lockup: an all-caps 'HUB' in HUB24 navy followed by '24' in the teal secondary. Run scripts/fetch-brand-assets.sh from an unrestricted network to replace these stand-ins with the official SVGs.
